description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ley Weaver to gain all creature types.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

uses.name: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
